evidence: Frozen v22_full backend is byte-identical to the audited source and declares V22_W_ORGANIZATION=multiplicative_nlo.
The backend entrypoint falls back to multiplicative when CSSConfig has no v22_w_organization attribute.
The frozen cache metadata records the v22 full backend path but no v22_w_organization override.
The historical export shell invokes the backend through the normal internal_css path and exposes no organization override.
The isolated strict branch differs from the historical multiplicative cache by up to 2.79% after the W transform on the diagnostic rows.
inference: The historical cache was most likely generated with the multiplicative NLO organization by default.
limit: The cache itself has no embedded organization label, so this remains an inference rather than a cryptographically explicit generator record.
required_resolution: Regenerate a tagged cache with explicit organization metadata before using strict-NLO wording as a verified provenance claim.
